upgrade_name: Wave 6.2 — Voice Upload Fix + User Tag Messaging + Friend Request System
goal: Fix the failing voice upload flow, implement driver lookup by tag format (name#number), and introduce a full friend request system with real-time updates — without breaking existing auth, validation, socket, or database architecture.

agents.responsibility: Diagnose and fix the failed audio upload issue end-to-end without breaking security or validation.

tasks.title: Audit upload route
actions: Inspect POST /api/upload/audio route
Verify multipart parsing works in Next.js App Router
Ensure request.formData() is used correctly
Ensure file size validation (10MB) is enforced safely
Ensure MIME type validation uses server-side file.type
Ensure UUID filename generation is correct
Ensure file is written to /public/uploads safely
Return descriptive errorResponse instead of generic failure

tasks.title: Improve error transparency
actions: Return structured { error, details? } on failure
Log server-side error safely (no sensitive data)
Ensure client displays meaningful toast error

tasks.title: Client-side fix
actions: Verify useVoiceRecorder produces valid Blob
Ensure FormData.append('file', blob, filename) is correct
Ensure correct Content-Type not manually overridden
Display upload failure reason in UI

definition_of_done: No generic 'failed to upload audio' message remains

agents.responsibility: Introduce driver identity tag system using format name#number for user lookup and messaging.

tasks.title: Generate unique tag on registration
actions: On user registration, generate tag format: name#random4digits
Ensure uniqueness via DB check or retry loop
Persist tag and tag_number
Expose tag in safe API responses (never password_hash)

tasks.title: Tag lookup endpoint
actions: Create GET /api/users/by-tag?tag=name#1234
Validate input with Zod
Return safe user info (id, name, tag)
Return 404 if not found

definition_of_done: User can search another driver using name#number

agents.responsibility: Implement a friend request system with DB persistence, API routes, and real-time socket notifications.

tasks.title: Friend request API routes
actions: POST /api/friends/request (send request)
PATCH /api/friends/[id]/accept
PATCH /api/friends/[id]/reject
GET /api/friends/list (accepted friends)
GET /api/friends/requests (pending requests)

tasks.title: Socket integration
actions: Emit friend_request_received event
Emit friend_request_accepted event
Update client UI in real time

definition_of_done: User can send friend request via tag search

agents.responsibility: Integrate tag messaging and friend system into UI.

tasks.title: Search by tag UI
actions: Add input field on Messages page: 'Enter driver tag (name#1234)'
Call GET /api/users/by-tag
Show result card with Send Friend Request button

tasks.title: Friend system UI
actions: Create Friends page
Show pending requests
Add Accept / Reject buttons
Show accepted friends list

tasks.title: Restrict direct messaging
actions: Allow sending voice message only if users are friends
Display warning if not friends

definition_of_done: Messaging limited to friends if enforced

must_pass: Voice messages can be sent using tag-based lookup

stop_condition: Voice upload fixed, tag-based lookup functional, friend system fully working with real-time updates and no regressions.
